articles.summary: How Precip's 2.5 km terrain downscaling and multi-model rain blend beat ECMWF IFS HRES and raw Google WeatherNext 3 across 2,200+ U.S. weather stations, giving you the world's best forecast two days early.

articles.summary: Frost can form when the air stays above 32°F. A local office can issue a frost advisory when the models do not show a freeze. Precip shows that alert and the frost probability for your locations.
articles.title: How can it frost when the temperature is above freezing?

articles.summary: Connect Precip to Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Muse, or any MCP client to ask how much rain fell, what's coming in the next hour, and how wet the soil is at your saved locations or any point in the US and Canada.
